Registering stock movements, deliveries, returns and material locations. Following strict cleanroom, hygiene and safety procedures. Wearing the required cleanroom clothing and protective equipment. Supporting production teams so machines and assembly processes can continue. Keeping materials, tools and working areas organised and contamination-free. This is mainly an active, hands-on position with a smaller administrative component. Functie-eisen You Will Be Successful In This Role If You enjoy active work, can follow clear instructions and understand that even a small mistake can affect an important production process. Can stay organised while priorities change. Enjoy active work and being on the move during your shift. Work well with colleagues from production and logistics. You receive training, clear instructions and the chance to build specialist experience inside one of the most advanced production environments in the Netherlands. An international workplace where English is commonly spoken. A team in which reliability, precision and cooperation matter. That is why FOUP & Reticle Operations is much more than simply moving materials. You protect the items that carry and create chip patterns. By keeping them clean, complete and available at the right moment, you help ASML’s production teams continue their work without unnecessary delays.

review_candidates.description: JOB DESCRIPTION Electrical Site Engineer Department: Engineering / Projects Department Job Title: Electrical Site Engineer Reports To: Project Manager / Construction Manager Direct Subordinates: Electrical Supervisors, Technicians, and Workers. 1. Job Purpose To supervise and manage all electrical site activities, ensuring that electrical works are executed according to approved drawings, technical specifications, quality standards, project schedules, and safety requirements. 2. Key Responsibilities & Duties 1. Supervise and monitor all electrical installation activities at the project site. 2. Review electrical shop drawings and ensure compliance with approved design drawings and specifications. 3. Supervise the installation of electrical cables, cable trays, and cable ladders. 4. Monitor the installation of electrical panels and distribution systems. 5. Supervise electrical power, lighting, and wiring installations. 6. Coordinate with other engineering disciplines to avoid conflicts during execution. 7. Manage and distribute daily tasks among electrical supervisors, technicians, and workers. 8. Ensure the availability of required materials, tools, and equipment. 9. Prepare daily and weekly progress reports. 10. Monitor project progress and ensure compliance with the approved project schedule. 11. Ensure the implementation of health, safety, and environmental regulations at the site. 12. Coordinate with consultants for inspections and approval of completed works. 13. Identify and resolve technical issues and execution problems in coordination with the relevant departments. 14. Supervise electrical testing, commissioning, and inspection activities. 15. Prepare quantity surveys and review electrical work quantities and progress statements. 16. Ensure that all materials used are approved and that no modifications are made without the required authorization. 3. Qualifications & Requirements * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (Power & Machines). * Previous experience in electrical site execution. * Good knowledge of electrical drawings and technical specifications. * Ability to read and interpret shop drawings and BOQs. * Proficiency in AutoCAD and Microsoft Office. * Good understanding of electrical installation standards and safety regulations. 4. Required Skills & Competencies * Leadership and team management skills. * Problem-solving and decision-making abilities. * Effective communication and coordination skills. * Time management and organizational skills. * Ability to work under pressure. * Attention to detail and accuracy. * Responsibility, commitment, and discipline. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 1. Achievement of project milestones according to the approved schedule. 2. First-time inspection approval rate. 3. Reduction of rework and execution errors. 4. Compliance with approved material consumption. 5. Compliance with health and safety standards. 6. Accuracy and timely submission of progress reports. 7. Efficiency in managing site teams and workforce. 8. Timely resolution of technical issues. 6. Authorities * Assign daily tasks to the electrical site team. * Request required materials, tools, and equipment. * Report technical issues and project obstacles to the Project Manager. * Stop non-compliant or unsafe activities in accordance with company procedures. 7. Working Conditions * Work primarily at project sites. * Commitment to working hours established by project management. * Willingness to relocate or move between company project sites when required. Prepared By: Human Resources Department

At Babcock, we’re working to create a safe and secure world, together. If you join us, you can play your part as a Service Support Engineer at Rosyth, near Dunfermline, Fife. The role As a Service Support Engineer, you'll become the technical focal point for a portfolio of advanced marine systems operating across the globe. This is an exciting opportunity to combine engineering expertise with customer-focused problem solving in a highly specialist environment. You'll work directly with customers to resolve complex technical challenges, improve system performance, and help ensure vessels operate safely, efficiently, and reliably. This role offers the chance to see the real-world impact of your work, influencing operational performance while collaborating with engineering, field service, project, and product teams. Whether you're solving technical issues, identifying improvements, or supporting future product development, you'll play a key role in delivering innovative solutions that make a difference. Day-to-day, you’ll be required to: Acting as the primary technical point of contact for customers across a portfolio of vessels and operators. Investigating and resolving complex engineering issues across electrical, control and instrumentation, mechanical, process, and marine systems. Managing technical enquiries, service requests, and warranty cases from diagnosis through to resolution. Monitoring fleet performance, identifying trends, and recommending improvements to enhance reliability and operational efficiency. Collaborating with engineering, project, field service, and product teams to drive continuous improvement and support future product development. This is a full-time, 37-hour per week role based at Rosyth. Hybrid working patterns are available, with an expectation of two days per week in the office. Travel to customer and operational sites will be expected, including occasional short-notice travel. Essential experience of the Service Support Engineer: Experience within Service Engineering, Technical Support, Field Service, Maintenance, Commissioning, or Operational Engineering environments supporting complex industrial equipment. Strong fault-finding, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills across electrical, control and instrumentation, mechanical, process, automation, or marine systems. Proven ability to manage technical issues from investigation through to successful resolution. Experience working directly with customers, operators, or end users and building effective working relationships. Ability to balance multiple priorities while delivering high levels of technical and customer support. Qualifications for the Service Support Engineer: Degree, Higher National Diploma, Higher National Certificate, or equivalent qualification in an engineering discipline. Alternatively, substantial relevant engineering experience in lieu of formal qualifications. Strong technical foundation in either electrical and control systems or mechanical and process engineering disciplines. Security Clearance The successful candidate must be able to achieve and maintain Security Check (SC) security clearance for this role. Many of the positions within our company are subject to national security clearance and Trade Control restrictions. This means that your eligibility for certain roles may be affected by your place of birth, nationality, current or former citizenship, and any residency you hold or have held. Further details are available at United Kingdom Security Vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK (www.gov.uk) . What We Offer Generous holiday allowance Matched contribution pension scheme, with life assurance Access to a Digital GP, annual health check, and nutritional consultations through Aviva DigiCare+ Employee shopping savings portal Payment of Professional Fees Reservists in the armed forces receive 10-days special paid leave Holiday Trading is a benefit that allows UK Babcock employees to buy additional leave or to sell up to one working week of annual leave from their annual entitlement. This Window opens February through to March annually. ‘Be Kind Day’ enables employees to take one working day's paid leave a year (or equivalent hours) to undertake volunteering work with their chosen organisation or registered charity Babcock We’re Babcock — a global FTSE 100 organisation with over 29,000 people working together to make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of something bigger. From initial design to final decommissioning, your work will contribute to products and services that are essential to national security and public infrastructure. Together, we’re building a future that lasts — not just through the impact we make, but through meaningful careers that respect your work-life balance. We call that lifetime engineering. Join us and see how far we can go, together. We are a disability confident committed employer. If you have a disability or need any reasonable adjustments during the application and selection stages, please email careers@babcockinternational.com with the subject header ‘Reasonable adjustments requirement’. We’re committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone’s free to thrive. We are happy to talk about flexible working – please ask about alternative patterns of work at interview. PCP specializes in transforming concepts into fully operational spaces that align with client requirements, offering fit-out, design & build, refurbishment, renovations, and facilities management under one integrated platform. Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field; advanced certifications in HVAC, fire protection, or building services are an advantage. Proven experience in site-based mechanical engineering roles within construction, fit-out, or mixed-use developments, ideally in a senior or lead capacity. Solid understanding of relevant codes, standards, and safety regulations, with a strong focus on quality assurance and compliance. Effective communication and leadership skills, with the ability to guide site teams, collaborate with stakeholders, and make sound technical decisions under time constraints. Proficiency in MS Office and project management tools; familiarity with BIM or coordination software is a plus.
